sn3.19:2.2: This accords with Arthaśāstra 3.5.28, “Property for which no claimant is found shall go to the king”.
sn3.19:2.3: This gives an idea of the prosperity of Sāvatthī in those days.
sn3.19:2.7: Hemp (_sāṇa_) made a rough  cloth. It was not known as an intoxicant.
sn3.19:2.9: Compare the splendid chariot of the brahmin Jānussoṇi ([sn45.4:1.3]()).
sn3.19:3.2: The proper use of wealth includes enjoying it oneself as well as helping others.
sn3.19:8.3: _Nisabha_ means “bull” and “chief”, both of which are covered by “boss”.
